badge.zh: 字节跳动 · Combo 已上线

summary.en: Seedance 2.0 and its Fast variant power the built-in video-generation Combo.
summary.zh: Seedance 2.0 与 Fast 版本为内置视频生成 Combo 提供执行能力。

title.en: Generate finished video work through a built-in Combo.
title.zh: 通过内置 Combo 完成视频生成工作。

description.en: The `seedance-video-generator` Combo uses Seedance 2.0 for text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame control, and synchronized audio. The Fast model accelerates drafts and storyboard clips.
description.zh: `seedance-video-generator` Combo 使用 Seedance 2.0 完成文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧控制与同步音频；Fast 型号用于快速生成草稿与分镜片段。

prompts.en: Animate these first and last frames

title.en: Quality and speed variants inside one Combo.
title.zh: 同一 Combo 中的质量版与快速版。

description.en: Both models are live through the Combo and do not appear in the main chat dropdown.
description.zh: 两个型号均已通过 Combo 上线，但不出现在主对话下拉菜单。

description.en: Text-to-video, image-to-video, frame control, and synchronized audio.
description.zh: 文生视频、图生视频、帧控制与同步音频。
快速生成视频草稿与分镜片段。

title.en: Brief, generate, then review the moving result.
title.zh: 明确简报、生成视频，再审阅动态结果。

description.en: Set subject, motion, framing, duration, frames, and audio needs.
description.zh: 明确主体、运动、构图、时长、帧与音频要求。

description.en: Use the full model for final work or Fast for early drafts.
description.zh: 成片使用完整型号，早期草稿使用 Fast。

description.en: Check motion, frames, audio, and brand fit before delivery.
description.zh: 交付前检查运动、帧、音频与品牌适配度。

answer.en: Use the built-in `seedance-video-generator` Combo. Seedance is not a main chat-dropdown option.
answer.zh: 通过内置 `seedance-video-generator` Combo 使用；Seedance 不属于主对话下拉选项。

question.en: What does the Fast model change?

answer.en: It prioritizes speed for video drafts and storyboard clips.
answer.zh: 它优先提高速度，用于视频草稿和分镜片段。

title.en: Run Seedance through the video Combo.
title.zh: 通过视频 Combo 使用 Seedance。

description.en: Choose the full engine for finished work or Fast for rapid iteration.
description.zh: 成片选择完整引擎，快速迭代选择 Fast。
